description: Skill triggering set for askit-onboard: verifies the skill fires on a request to get started with this toolkit, a request for a personalized adoption plan, and a return visit asking what to do next, and stays silent on greenfield plugin scaffolding, foreign-repo migration, single-component authoring or fixing, and plain tier/conformance questions that name an existing skill directly.

cases.query: I'm new to this toolkit, where do I even start
help me get started adopting agent-skills-toolkit for my plugin
survey my plugin and tell me where I stand with this toolkit
assess how far along I am adopting this toolkit's skills
interview me and build a personalized plan for adopting this toolkit
plan out my adoption of this toolkit over the next few weeks
I don't want to read every doc page, just tell me what to do in order
sequence the steps for me to go from nothing to a graded tier, personalized to my repo
I was here last week working through a plan, what's next
pick up where my onboarding roadmap left off
what should I do next in my adoption plan
re-enter my askit onboarding roadmap and tell me the next step
I have a plugin already, tell me which parts of this toolkit I haven't touched yet
onboard me into using this toolkit well over time, not just once
what capability regions of this toolkit am I missing, sequenced for me personally
start a new plugin from scratch
scaffold a new plugin with the full Bronze anatomy, I have no code yet
I have a folder of Claude skills I want to bring up to the Standard
adopt this foreign skills library into my plugin ecosystem
fix the description quality of this skill
fix the broken reference links in my skill
build me a new command for this plugin right now
run a conformance check on my plugin and tell me the tier
what tier does my plugin currently reach
write the minimal library.json so this repo becomes gradeable
create a new skill inside my existing plugin
